research_question: Among adults undergoing cardiac surgery, what is the effect of perioperative levosimendan versus placebo on all-cause mortality?
outcome_description: All-cause mortality, analyzed as a dichotomous outcome using each trial's reported number of deaths and total number randomized in each arm. Pool risk ratios on an intention-to-treat/randomized-denominator basis where available. Trials with zero deaths in both arms are not estimable for the risk ratio and will be excluded from the pooled estimate without applying a continuity correction; they will still be retained in the qualitative review and reported separately.
positive_direction: A result favoring levosimendan means lower all-cause mortality with levosimendan than with placebo (for the requested risk ratio, RR < 1 favors levosimendan; if represented on a signed standardized direction, a positive value would indicate benefit from levosimendan).
search_queries: levosimendan placebo cardiac surgery randomized trial mortality
levosimendan cardiac surgery controlled trial deaths
perioperative levosimendan placebo adults mortality trial
inclusion_criteria: Original empirical studies of adults undergoing cardiac surgery that compare perioperative levosimendan with placebo.
Randomized or controlled comparative trials reporting all-cause mortality at any reported follow-up time.
Studies providing, or allowing derivation of, deaths and total randomized per treatment arm or other quantitative information sufficient to assess mortality.
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study, including systematic reviews, meta-analyses, editorials, opinion pieces, protocols without results, and theoretical papers.
No comparison between a levosimendan treatment condition and a placebo control condition.

No quantitative outcome data capable of producing an effect size, such as deaths and randomized totals, proportions, odds ratios, or equivalent statistics; means with SDs or t/F-values are acceptable generally but must pertain to an effect-size-compatible outcome.
Completely unrelated to levosimendan use in adults undergoing cardiac surgery or to all-cause mortality.
moderators_to_extract: Type of cardiac surgery (e.g., CABG, valve, combined, other)
Baseline ventricular function or left ventricular ejection fraction eligibility
Levosimendan dose, loading-dose use, infusion duration, and timing relative to surgery
Trial design and setting, including single-center versus multicenter
Baseline surgical risk and use of cardiopulmonary bypass
effect_size_note: Use the Risk Ratio (RR) calculated from each trial's reported deaths and total randomized per arm. Prefer intention-to-treat denominators and the longest clearly reported all-cause mortality follow-up per trial unless the review protocol prespecifies another single time point. Pool log RRs with inverse-variance weighting and present pooled RR with 95% CI; assess heterogeneity with tau-squared, I-squared, and Cochran's Q, using a random-effects model as the primary analysis and a fixed-effect model as sensitivity analysis where appropriate. Trials with zero deaths in both arms are non-estimable and must be excluded from pooling without continuity correction; enumerate and describe these trials separately. For trials with zero deaths in only one arm, apply a standard prespecified continuity correction only as needed for RR computation and examine alternative corrections in sensitivity analysis. Avoid double-counting participants across multiple reports of the same trial.
